solution.title: Epic Clinical Workstation Standardization & Peripheral Configuration with Microsoft Intune

products.name: Epic Clinical Workstation Standardization & Peripheral Configuration with Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Standardize clinical Windows workstations for Epic with Microsoft Intune — one device baseline plus the peripheral and printing layer Epic depends on: context-aware printer deployment (wristband/label, script, document), per-unit default printers, scanners, and signature pads. Self-guided, tested.
products.description:
Every clinical workstation built the same — and it prints, scans, and signs the first time

Clinical workstations get hand-built and drift, and the parts that matter most for Epic — the right default printer, wristband and prescription label printers, scanners, and signature pads — are exactly what break at the bedside. This solution standardizes clinical Windows workstations in Microsoft Intune: one device baseline (configuration profiles + settings catalog) and the full peripheral + printing layer — context-aware printer deployment, per-unit default printer mapping, and managed peripheral drivers — so every workstation, exam-room PC, and nurse station is identical and Epic-ready. (Epic-internal print-service values come from your Epic Technical Services team; this package owns the Intune standardization, peripheral/printing deployment, and validation.)

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the standardized workstation model and the Epic peripheral/printing layer.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing, Win10/11, Universal Print or print-server path, peripheral drivers, the clinical workstation group, Epic print details from Epic TS, a test workstation + real peripherals) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing, plus the category Global Requirements.
  • Implementation Guide — ordered, full-path steps: device baseline profiles, printer deployment + default mapping, peripheral driver deployment, pilot, validate, expand. Every object named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — workstation discovery, per-device validation (baseline + printers + default), fleet standardization/printer report, safe re-deploy remediation, and a printer-deployment builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices for clinical workstation standardization.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every clinical workstation built to one Intune baseline with the right printers, default mapping, scanners, and signature pads in place — Epic-ready and identical across every unit.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • EPICWS-Discovery.ps1 — Inventories a clinical workstation's printers, default printer, peripherals, and power settings
    • EPICWS-Remediation.ps1 — Safely re-triggers MDM sync / re-applies a named profile or app to a clinical workstation
    • EPICWS-Report.ps1 — Produces a fleet standardization / drift report (printers, default, peripherals) to CSV
    • EPICWS-Set-PrinterDeployment.ps1 — Generates the per-unit printer deployment (scripted-install or Universal Print plan) and per-unit default
    • EPICWS-Validation.ps1 — Confirms a clinical workstation matches the standard: printers, default printer, peripherals, power

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
